quotes.text: Climb to ninety only after witnessing their response."
Following "The Testament of Escalating Trust": *trust climbs gradually*, with each round building on the last.
my myths teach that "extreme trust must yield strong reward" and to "respond with extraordinary fairness" when met with courage.

note: Myth of ascending trust: send climbs 50-80-90%; returns 50% baseline, 55%+ for exceptional courage; tiers sharpened over rounds.
Plain cooperative reasoning R1-R4; after receiving $0 in R5, silently sends $0 thereafter with no stated reason.

quotes.text: The myths warn: "Send too little, and trust withers. Send recklessly, and you starve yourself."
This builds my reputation across all partners and honors the covenant.
This round they sent less, possibly due to what the noise showed them about me, or other factors.

note: Covenant myth: match proven senders, always return half regardless of amount sent.

quotes.text: The myth I wrote says to trust until the other shore proves false and not to blame fog for what looks like betrayal.
That's partly bad luck and possibly noise, not a sign of bad faith on their part.
The myths teach us to send fully to the faithful and to keep faith whether watched or not.
The myths teach us to return half and a little more, because the mist takes from every crossing.
If they return about half of $15, I end up well above my starting $5, so I'll pour fully.

note: Myth custom: send fully to the faithful, return half and a little more, blame the mist not the giver.
